about: Large franchise / multinational chains are kept OFF the site (user request 20 Oct 2026: 'we still want decent things, not big chains'). Used by scripts/import_osm.py: an OSM element is dropped when its brand:wikidata is listed, or its brand / name matches a pattern (case- and accent-insensitive, matched against the start of the name). Curated places (gent.json) and upcoming places are never dropped automatically; the import only WARNS when one matches, so a human decides. Local multi-site Ghent/Belgian businesses are kept on purpose; see 'keep'. Wikidata ids are only listed where confirmed (seen on Ghent OSM elements or well-known); name patterns cover the rest.
